item.title: Soaring Food Prices Push Shop Inflation Higher as SNP Attacks Labour Record
item.description: Rising food prices pushed UK shop inflation higher in December, adding pressure to household budgets as the SNP accuses Labour of failing families on the cost of living amid higher energy bills and growing concerns about affordability.The post Soaring Food Prices Push Shop Inflation Higher as SNP Attacks Labour Record appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: UK New Car Market Breaks Two Million as Electric Vehicles Surge
item.description: The UK new car market passed two million registrations in 2025 as electric vehicle sales surged, with almost one in four buyers going electric, while industry leaders warn the pace of change remains costly and government action is urgently needed.The post UK New Car Market Breaks Two Million as Electric Vehicles Surge appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland and Moray Communities Invited to Shape Lynx Reintroduction Plans
item.description: Communities across the Highlands and Moray are being invited to help shape plans for a possible lynx reintroduction, with public events launching this month to explore benefits, concerns and how people and wildlife could coexist.The post Highland and Moray Communities Invited to Shape Lynx Reintroduction Plans appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Consultation Launched on Raising Minimum Marriage Age in Scotland
item.description: Scotland is consulting on proposals to raise the minimum age of marriage and civil partnership from 16 to 18, alongside wider reforms to family law aimed at improving protection, fairness and transparency for young people and families.The post Consultation Launched on Raising Minimum Marriage Age in Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Visitor Levy Bill Gives Councils Greater Freedom Over Tourism Charges
item.description: New legislation would give councils greater flexibility over visitor levies, allowing fixed charges on overnight stays as an alternative to percentage based models, with ministers saying the changes could help boost local tourism services and economies.The post New Visitor Levy Bill Gives Councils Greater Freedom Over Tourism Charges appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Freezing Conditions Continue to Disrupt Communities Across Highlands and Islands
item.description: Freezing temperatures and icy conditions continue to disrupt communities across the Highlands and Islands, with councils, emergency services and the Scottish Government urging caution as winter operations remain under way.The post Freezing Conditions Continue to Disrupt Communities Across Highlands and Islands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Thousands of Lives Could be Saved Under Sweeping New Road Safety Strategy
item.description: A major new UK Road Safety Strategy aims to cut deaths and serious injuries by 65 percent by 2035, with proposals including lower drink drive limits, tougher rules for young and older drivers, and new vehicle safety technology.The post Thousands of Lives Could be Saved Under Sweeping New Road Safety Strategy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Labour Infighting Erupts as Starmer Allies Brand Scottish MPs “Idiots”
item.description: Labour is facing mounting turmoil after allies of Keir Starmer branded Scottish MPs “idiots”, exposing deep divisions ahead of the Holyrood election and raising fresh questions about leadership, unity and political credibility in Scotland.The post Labour Infighting Erupts as Starmer Allies Brand Scottish MPs “Idiots” appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Keeping Shetland Moving as Crews Battle Cold to Catch Up On Missed Bin Collections
item.description: Bin crews across Shetland are working through freezing conditions to catch up on missed waste and recycling collections, with extra weekend runs planned as island communities show patience and resilience during another challenging winter spell.The post Keeping Shetland Moving as Crews Battle Cold to Catch Up On Missed Bin Collections appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Recovery Under Way as Communities Begin to Emerge From Severe Weather
item.description: Recovery is under way across northern Scotland as severe weather eases, with transport links reopening, schools working towards a return, and resilience partners focusing support on communities most affected by recent snow and ice.The post Recovery Under Way as Communities Begin to Emerge From Severe Weather appeared first on The Highland Times.
